name: tree
description: In progress: A live file tree pane: the whole working directory, git status colors, and a shimmer on the file Claude is editing.

side.title: Dock side
side.description: Preferred side for the pane. This Claude Code build docks panes on the right; the setting applies once a build lets a plugin choose.

openOnStart.title: Open at start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a fullscreen terminal.

followClaude.title: Follow Claude
followClaude.description: Expand and scroll to the file Claude is editing.

readsShimmer.title: Shimmer on reads
readsShimmer.description: Shimmer (muted) while Claude reads a file, not only while it writes.

shimmer.title: Shimmer style
shimmer.description: sweep: a bright window moves across the name; pulse: the name blinks bold once a second; off: static highlight.

compactFolders.title: Compact folders
compactFolders.description: Draw a chain of single-child folders on one row (src/main/java).

collapsedFolders.title: Folders folded at first
collapsedFolders.description: Comma-separated folder names, matched at any depth, drawn folded until you open them (node_modules). Empty folds nothing.

hiddenFolders.title: Hidden folders
hiddenFolders.description: Comma-separated folder names, matched at any depth, left out of the tree and its find (dist, .venv). The Changes view still lists their changes.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Hex color the pane's light comes from: the glass's warm top, the glow around the file Claude is editing, the lit guide and the focus edge.

glow.title: Ember glow
glow.description: Light the rows around the file Claude is editing, fading out when the edit ends.

glass.title: Glass
glass.description: Draw the pane on a slab of tinted glass, warm at the top and cool at the bottom. Off, rows sit on the terminal's own background.

animate.title: Animate folds
animate.description: Ripple rows in and out when a folder opens or closes.

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: What the o key runs to open a file: {path} is its absolute path, {line} the preview's top line. Use an editor that opens its own window (a terminal editor cannot take over Claude's screen).

previewIn.title: Preview in
previewIn.description: Where a file preview shows. band: above the prompt, as wide as the transcript, driven from the tree pane. pane: inside the tree pane.
